ratified_by: PENDING — first draft 2026-05-03 awaiting Matt review
doctrine: Lane discipline. Each system has one role. Mergers blur authority and corrupt evidence.
purpose: Enumerate the responsibility boundaries that must NEVER blur across Falcon, Helios, ARES, Solo, NEO, R2D2, PLUTUS. Gatekeeper raises an alarm on any code/data evidence of merger.

rules.rule: FALCON shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: Falcon detects setups and emits structured fires. Falcon does not place orders, manage positions, size risk, or call brokers.
rules.current_state: PASSING — evidence sweep confirms zero execution code in /srv-dev/falcon/

rules.rule: HELIOS shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: Helios advises alignment state. Helios does not execute. Solo/Matt/NEO decide whether to act on the advice.
rules.current_state: PASSING on Trinity (/srv/helios). UNVERIFIED on dell-debian (V3 daemon not inspected); gatekeeper recommends adding tripwire to V3 daemon parity with trader-xau-watcher.

rules.what_it_means: Helios consumes Falcon's persisted output (helios_strategy_signals). Helios does not detect setups, does not import Falcon strategy modules, does not run worker.evaluate().
rules.tripwire: Helios source must not import from falcon.strategies.*. Schema check on dependency manifest.

rules.what_it_means: ARES vetoes risk (event windows, liquidity gates, drawdown). Helios advises alignment. Two different decisions on two different systems. ARES gates appear AS PASSTHROUGH inside helios:state — ARES does not author helios.decision.
rules.tripwire: ares:* keys may not contain decision/v3_tier/composite_confidence. helios:state:* may contain ares.gates as passthrough only — never authored by ARES.
rules.current_state: PASSING per evidence — helios:state:XAU_USD.ares.gates is structured passthrough, not authored.

rules.rule: R2D2 shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: R2D2 audits and backtests. R2D2 does not place orders, does not advise execution, does not override Solo. R2D2's outputs are evidence, not commands.
rules.tripwire: R2D2 fabric writes restricted to r2d2:* namespace. NO writes to falcon:*, helios:*, ares:*, trader:*, neo:* by R2D2 process.
rules.current_state: PASSING — confirmed by namespace discipline + auto-memory rules in CLAUDE.md.

rules.what_it_means: R2D2 may build PORTS of Falcon strategies for backtest replay (e.g. /srv/r2d2/scripts/csdr_session_sweep/csdr_engine.py — pure-Python port of CSDR state machine). Ports are AUDIT INSTRUMENTS — clearly labelled, never substitute Falcon's canonical implementation in production.
rules.tripwire: R2D2 strategy ports MUST include header docstring: 'AUDIT INSTRUMENT — NOT CANONICAL FALCON. Source of truth: /srv-dev/falcon/strategies/<plugin>/worker.py'. R2D2 must re-port (not patch) when canonical Falcon code changes.
rules.current_state: PARTIAL — csdr_engine.py exists; needs header annotation. Gatekeeper TODO.

rules.rule: R2D2 shall not own OUTCOME TRUTH
rules.what_it_means: Falcon's outcome_resolver.py (wick_aware method, architect-ratified WO-OUTCOME-RESOLVER-METHODOLOGY-0001 2026-04-29) is canonical for fire outcomes. R2D2 may audit disagreements (write to r2d2:audit:* namespace) but never substitute resolver truth in helios_strategy_signals.outcome_*.
rules.tripwire: R2D2 process must not UPDATE helios_strategy_signals.outcome_* columns. Read-only on those columns.
rules.current_state: PASSING per design — needs DB-grant audit to confirm.

rules.rule: helios_strategy_signals despite the name IS OWNED BY FALCON
rules.what_it_means: The table is misleadingly named. Writers: Falcon signal_feed.py (canonical) + historically Helios scanners (frozen). Readers: Solo, Helios V3 daemon, R2D2 audits. The naming is a legacy artefact from V2 era.
rules.tripwire: Any new writer to helios_strategy_signals must be Falcon-side. Helios writes are forbidden. Documentation must always describe this table as 'Falcon\'s output table (legacy name).'
rules.future_consideration: Renaming to falcon_strategy_signals would be cleaner (Helm/architect decision). Cost: migration of all readers. Gatekeeper documents the misnomer; defers rename decision.

rules.rule: NEO shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: NEO observes, scores, audits, coaches. NEO never places live trades. NEO trades FTMO_PRACTICE_100K only (per shared_rule_neo_practice_only — Matt 2026-04-22).
rules.tripwire: NEO process broker connection must be FTMO_PRACTICE_100K only. Live broker connection forbidden by config.

rules.rule: PLUTUS is the SIMULATION ENVIRONMENT, not the production environment
rules.what_it_means: All training, replay, and what-if happens in PLUTUS. Live execution flows through Solo → IBKR (Live) only. PLUTUS sim broker results never feed live decision systems.
rules.tripwire: trader:gate:composite production reads must never include plutus.* sources. PLUTUS state writes must never collide with live state keys.
rules.current_state: UNVERIFIED in this evidence sweep; documented as architectural rule per CLAUDE.md.

rules.rule: Solo (the trader) shall not become FALCON
rules.what_it_means: Solo reads helios_strategy_signals (or trader:gate:composite) and decides whether to execute. Solo does not author fires. Solo does not author Helios state.
rules.tripwire: Solo process must be read-only on helios_strategy_signals, helios:state:*. Solo writes only to its own trade-state namespace.
rules.current_state: UNVERIFIED — gatekeeper TODO to audit Solo's DB grants and fabric write permissions.

rules.what_it_means: ARES emits risk gate state. ARES does not detect setups. Falcon may READ ARES gate state observationally (in risk_context.ares_state) but ARES does not generate proposals.
rules.tripwire: ARES code must not import falcon.strategies.*. ARES outputs must be gate state only (event/liquidity/drawdown), never proposals.
rules.current_state: PASSING per architectural design — no inverse imports observed.

on_violation_detected: 1. STOP downstream consumption immediately if gate-grade violation (fail closed).
2. Bake gatekeeper alarm to r2d2:alarm:forbidden_merge:<rule_id>:<utc> with evidence (file paths, code excerpts, fabric snapshots).
3. Discord-ping Matt with rule violated, location, and recommended action.
5. Request architect review before re-enabling boundary.
on_grey_area: 1. Do NOT make a unilateral call.
2. Document the grey area as r2d2:gatekeeper:grey:<topic>:<utc>.
